name: Mr.ASH (variational empirical Bayes multiple regression)
model_likelihood: y | X,b,sigma^2 ~ N(Xb,sigma^2 I); individual-level design
prior: b_j iid sum_k pi_k N(0,sigma^2 sigma_k^2); estimate mixture weights
inference_algorithm: Mean-field ELBO coordinate ascent over q_j, mixture weights and sigma^2
estimand: Approximate posterior of b and its mean for prediction
data_input: Response vector y and predictor matrix X
tunable_settings: Number and grid of prior variances (including zero); initialization; update order; stopping tolerance

name: Empirical Bayes normal means (building block)
model_likelihood: y_j | b_j,sigma^2 ~ N(b_j,sigma^2), known noise variance
prior: Shared scaled adaptive shrinkage normal-mixture prior (3)-(4)
inference_algorithm: Estimate mixture weights by marginal likelihood; compute posterior given estimated prior
estimand: Coefficient posterior conditional on fitted prior
data_input: Normal-means observations and known common noise variance
tunable_settings: Fixed grid of component variances and number of components
